controls.title: #1 Cross-site Scripting (CWE-79)
controls.summary: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation.

controls.title: #2 Out-of-bounds Write (CWE-787)
controls.summary: Writing past the end or before the beginning of a buffer.

controls.title: #3 SQL Injection (CWE-89)
controls.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command.

controls.title: #4 Cross-Site Request Forgery (CWE-352)
controls.summary: The web app does not verify that a request was intentionally sent by the user.

controls.title: #5 Path Traversal (CWE-22)
controls.summary: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory.

controls.title: #6 Out-of-bounds Read (CWE-125)
controls.summary: Reading data past the end or before the beginning of a buffer.

controls.title: #7 OS Command Injection (CWE-78)
controls.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command.

controls.title: #8 Use After Free (CWE-416)
controls.summary: Referencing memory after it has been freed.

controls.title: #9 Missing Authorization (CWE-862)
controls.summary: The software does not perform an authorization check on a protected resource.

controls.title: #10 Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type (CWE-434)
controls.summary: The software allows upload of files that can be executed or interpreted.

controls.title: #11 Code Injection (CWE-94)
controls.summary: Improper control of generation of code.

controls.title: #12 Improper Input Validation (CWE-20)
controls.summary: The product does not validate or incorrectly validates input.

controls.title: #13 Command Injection (CWE-77)
controls.summary: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command.
implementationChecklist: Use safe APIs, avoid command concatenation

controls.title: #14 Improper Authentication (CWE-287)
controls.summary: The product does not prove or insufficiently proves an actor's identity.

controls.title: #15 Improper Privilege Management (CWE-269)
controls.summary: The product does not properly assign, manage, or track privileges.

controls.title: #16 Deserialization of Untrusted Data (CWE-502)
controls.summary: The product deserializes untrusted data without sufficient verification.
implementationChecklist: Avoid native deserialization of untrusted input

controls.title: #17 Exposure of Sensitive Information (CWE-200)
controls.summary: The product exposes sensitive information to an unauthorized actor.

controls.title: #18 Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863)
controls.summary: The product performs an authorization check incorrectly.

controls.title: #19 Server-Side Request Forgery (CWE-918)
controls.summary: The web server receives a URL and retrieves its contents without validation.

controls.title: #20 Improper Restriction of Operations within Bounds of a Memory Buffer (CWE-119)
controls.summary: Operations on a memory buffer are not restricted to its bounds.

controls.title: #21 NULL Pointer Dereference (CWE-476)
controls.summary: A NULL pointer dereference occurs when the application dereferences a pointer it expects to be valid.

controls.title: #22 Use of Hard-coded Credentials (CWE-798)
controls.summary: The product contains hard-coded credentials for inbound or outbound authentication.

controls.title: #23 Integer Overflow or Wraparound (CWE-190)
controls.summary: An integer overflow or wraparound leads to incorrect behavior.

controls.title: #24 Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (CWE-400)
controls.summary: The product does not control allocation and maintenance of a limited resource.

controls.title: #25 Missing Authentication for Critical Function (CWE-306)
controls.summary: The product does not perform authentication for functionality that requires it.
